verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 3 resolves the prior major finding. The change no longer claims bounded or starvation-free traversal: it states that timestamp hashing provides probabilistic fairness, explicitly documents the nonzero residual tail and absence of a per-row deadline, and explains why replacing deterministic zero service beyond the fixed capacity cut-off with an approximately uniform chance per tick is sufficient for the scoped defect. The implementation preserves every admitted row as a pure rotation, partitions by exact repository match before ordering, validates the hostile timestamp against the same shared grammar at both artifact and service-order boundaries, and binds dispatch() to the tested queue helper. The self-tests pin exact offsets, totality, rotation shape, reproducibility, malformed-input refusal, per-repository delivery, the live call-site arguments, and non-vacuity against representative permissive mutations. I found no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue in the diff.
